title: Look up how many students miss class in your Michigan school
summary_en: Statewide, more than 1 in 4 Michigan K-12 students are missing more than 10% of the school year. The rate is down slightly from the previous year but ‘more work remains,’ according to the state superintendent.
author: Isabel Lohman
title_cn: Look up how many students miss class in your Michigan school

title: Michigan absenteeism inches down; 1 in 4 still miss too much school
summary_en: The state’s chronic absenteeism rates have decreased for the fourth year in a row, but more than a fourth of students are missing 10% or more of the school year.
author: Isabel Lohman
title_cn: Michigan absenteeism inches down; 1 in 4 still miss too much school
